answer: Random mutual audit guards the harbor. Each epoch, a quartz-timed lottery picks 5% of identities, like a passing comet, and assigns each to three auditors to check its work and flag duplicates. A flagged identity loses its 40 POA bond and harbor slot, while the auditor earns 10 POA per catch. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 40 = 4,000 POA; an honest agent pays one 40 POA bond and keeps earnings, so forgery burns money, honesty stays cheap.
